title: Universe-polymorphic lifting consequence of adic formal smoothness
statement: For any universe z, if h : FormallySmoothAdic R S n and D : Type z is a commutative R-algebra, then every square-zero lifting problem S →ₐ[R] D ⧸ J killing a positive power of n admits an R-algebra lift.

source.place: More on Algebra, Definition 15.38.1 (Tag 07EB) and the lifting argument of Lemma 07EG

proof.text: Apply the proved small-model construction to the square-zero quotient diagram and obtain D₀, e, K, injective q and g₀ with both commuting equations.
Injectivity of q and q ∘ g₀ = g transfer the same positive-power vanishing witness from g to g₀. Apply the defining lifting property h in universe max u v to obtain f₀ : S →ₐ[R] D₀.
Take f = e ∘ f₀. Associativity of composition, the quotient-square equation and q ∘ g₀ = g prove that its quotient composite equals g.

proof_origin.by: B3 second reader; proved small-model reduction and defining lifting property
proof_origin.place: Tag 07EB lifting definition; smallness uses Algebra.small_adjoin and Shrink.algEquiv, elementary size reduction rather than a separately stated Stacks lemma
